title: The Borrowed Weather
author: Jude Eriksen
blurb: Wendell Vasquez, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
